entry.author: Climate Change Commission
entry.summary:
22 October 2025
How can independent climate advisory bodies accelerate effective climate action in the Asia-Pacific region? 

This webinar, hosted by the International Climate Councils Network (ICCN), Asia Society and Sustainable Futures Collaborative, shared the latest work on climate governance, including local climate councils, in the region.

Speakers:
• Ben Ross and Tessa Vincent, ICCN
• Dr Christopher Bartlett, Special Climate Adviser, Vanuatu Ministry of Climate Change 
• Betty Wang, Senior Programme Officer, Asia Society
• Jo Hendy, Chief Executive, Climate Change Commission (New Zealand)
• Weilin Chiu, Acting General Manager - Systems and Science Branch, Climate Change Authority (Australia)
• Kang Yoo-sik, Director of the International Cooperation Division, Presidential Commission on Carbon Neutrality and Green Growth (Republic of Korea)
